meta.title: SAP PR Sync Mode (integration.sap.pr.sync_mode) = Push (SAP → Procol) (default)
gaps: Set the tenant setting integration.sap.pr.sync_mode to Push (SAP → Procol).
Configure or inspect PR Sync Modes as real-time or scheduled batch.
Observe or verify that Purchase Requisition data flows from SAP to Procol under Push mode.
Compare the observed behavior with the Push (SAP → Procol) oracle.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set the tenant setting integration.sap.pr.sync_mode to Push (SAP → Procol).; Configure or inspect PR Sync Modes as real-time or scheduled batch.; Observe or verify that Purchase Requisition data flows from SAP to Procol under Push mode.; Compare the observed behavior with the Push (SAP → Procol) oracle.

args.need: sign in as the Tenant Admin, open the SAP PR Sync Mode setting, select Push (SAP → Procol), inspect or configure the Real-time and Batch PR Sync Modes, and verify that Purchase Requisition data flows from SAP to Procol

steps.note: A tester is required because the catalog cannot access tenant integration settings or observe SAP-to-Procol synchronization.
Assert that the session remains free of visible application errors after the tester completes the unavailable integration check.
